product_one_liner.value: Envoy is a workplace-management platform for facilities, security, and IT teams to manage visitors, spaces, and communications while improving workplace security and compliance.

pricing_page.notes: Public plan information includes an Enterprise tier with custom pricing.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company-size range as 201–500 employees.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include Shraddha Chadha’s AI threat-detection pipeline article (August 10, 2026) and Matthew Ellwood’s React-in-Ember migration article (July 16, 2026).

public_docs.notes: Public documentation contains multiple guides covering getting started, authentication, app development, APIs, and webhooks.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The complete, unfiltered board lists 20 openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title; Senior Data Analyst, Marketing does not qualify.

model_provider.notes: Anthropic powers document parsing; Amazon Rekognition supports returning-visitor detection and ID-scanning facial matching.

compliance_certs.notes: Publicly listed compliance claims; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance frameworks rather than formal certifications.

last_funding.notes: Latest recorded funding round, announced January 11, 2022.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round was January 2022, outside the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Open roles include Mid Market Account Executive in San Francisco and EMEA Outbound BDR in London.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 1, 2026 release announcement introduces Envoy Response, combining threat intelligence and incident management.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Envoy announced Mauricio Ramirez’s appointment as Chief Revenue Officer on February 26, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These tools are named in the current Mid Market Account Executive posting.
